verdict: Paid campaigns are off; organic reach is the only active signal and it's declining.
narrative: Your paid channels — Meta and Google Ads — have been inactive for the full 28-day window, meaning zero ad spend and zero paid leads this period. Your Google Business Profile remained the only source of incoming activity, generating 91 actions (19 calls, 29 direction requests, 43 website clicks), though that volume is down 17% week-over-week and has gone quiet in the last few days. Instagram reach also fell 34% week-over-week, so organic amplification is softening alongside the profile activity. Paid campaigns are being reactivated to restore a reliable lead pipeline; once live, you should see new contacts entering your CRM, which has been idle this period only because no new traffic is being driven to it.
